inputs.subject: Tax help request: 2023 filing details (Head of Household, Phoenix AZ)
inputs.body:
Hi Vince,

Can you review the tax information and advise what can be deducted, whether to itemize or take the standard deduction, how to treat the home office, and what forms the taxpayer needs to file for 2023? Details below:

- Filing status: Head of household, Phoenix, AZ
- W-2: TechStart Inc — $84,900
- Additional income: $12,500 (IT contracting, 2 clients)
- Interest/investment income: $1,450 from Goldman Sachs Marcus; $480 from E*TRADE
- Home office: 165 sq ft exclusive use; rental: $1,720/month for 780 sq ft (annual rent $20,640)
- Deductions/expenses: $4,400 student loan interest (Navient, 2016–2020) — please confirm whether any of this was paid in 2023; $800 to St. Mary's Food Bank (receipt available); $950 unreimbursed expenses

Questions / items to check:
- Eligibility for the student loan interest deduction (limit $2,500 and MAGI phaseouts) — taxpayer's MAGI likely exceeds the phaseout, but please confirm with exact rules and whether any portion is deductible.
- Whether to itemize vs. take the 2023 Head of Household standard deduction ($20,800) given the available itemizable amounts.
- Treatment of the $12,500 contracting income: Schedule C? Any 1099-NEC expected? Self-employment tax (Schedule SE) and estimated payments.
- Home office: simplified method (165 sq ft x $5 = $825) vs. actual expense allocation (165/780 ≈ 21.15% of rent → rent portion ≈ $4,366 plus proportionate utilities/insurance) — advise which is more appropriate and documentation needed (Form 8829 if using actual expenses).
- Charitable donation: $800 — deductible only if itemizing.
- Unreimbursed expenses: if related to self-employment, include on Schedule C; if employee unreimbursed, no deduction under current law.
- Forms likely needed: Form 1040, Schedule 1 (additional income/adjustments), Schedule C, Schedule SE, Form 8829 (if using actual home-office expenses), Form 8995/8995-A for QBI if eligible, and Arizona state return (AZ Form 140). Please confirm and add anything else relevant.

Please advise recommended steps and any documentation to gather. Thanks!

Best,
[Automated tax referral from user's assistant]
